definitions.explanation: A person who looks after a warehouse — receiving deliveries, managing inventory, and watching over stored goods. Also the Japanese name of the puzzle video game known internationally as Sokoban.

examples.japanese: {倉庫番|そうこばん}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work as a warehouse keeper.

examples.japanese: {倉庫番|そうこばん}は{在庫|ざいこ}{管理|かんり}も{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: The warehouseman is also in charge of inventory management.

examples.japanese: 「{倉庫番|そうこばん}」は{箱|はこ}を{押|お}して{所定|しょてい}の{場所|ばしょ}に{運|はこ}ぶパズルゲームだ。
examples.english: Sokoban is a puzzle game in which you push boxes to designated spots.

notes:
Compound of {倉庫|そうこ} (warehouse) + {番|ばん} (watch, guard duty). The 〜{番|ばん} suffix indicates someone on duty watching a place: {留守番|るすばん} (house-sitter), {店番|みせばん} (shop minder).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倉庫番|そうこばん}を{務|つと}める: to work as a warehouse keeper
- {倉庫番|そうこばん}{担当|たんとう}: warehouse-keeper role
- {倉庫番|そうこばん}のゲーム: the Sokoban game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {倉庫|そうこ}{係|がかり}: warehouse staff — emphasizes assignment to the role
- {在庫|ざいこ}{管理|かんり}{担当|たんとう}: inventory manager — more formal/modern job title
